اعتزلن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَلْنَ (iʕtazalna) /iʕ.ta.zal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اُعْتُزِلْنَ (uʕtuzilna) /uʕ.tu.zil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اِعْتَزِلْنَ (iʕtazilna) /iʕ.ta.zil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
